scope: All four public Statistics banks: stems, choices, keyed answers, explanations, and supplied box-plot summaries.
policy: Do not distinguish correct answers by sample-quartile/sample-percentile algorithms, interpolation, median inclusion, or tie/rank choices. Use supplied summaries or convention-robust choices. Avoid exact sample-quartile counts and fence-equality minutiae. Continuous-model quantiles remain in scope.
